note: Logical coherence of each organiser baseline's own Task-1 global alignment. 'unsat' is the number of unsatisfiable named classes in the merged ontology O_src ∪ O_tgt ∪ M, where M is the system's submitted alignment asserted as EquivalentClasses; the incoherence degree is that count over the counted named classes (union_class_count). Computed organiser-side with ROBOT 1.9.10. ELK is a sound lower bound (unsat_ELK ≤ unsat_HermiT); HermiT is exact and is run on NCIT-DOID only.
basis: The same conventions as the 2026 participant results (participant_results.json) and the reference figures (reference_coherence.json): only '=' correspondences are asserted; deprecated classes and imports are excluded during the calculation.

footnotes.elk_lower_bound: Every ELK figure is a sound under-approximation of the exact count.
footnotes.hermit_scale: HermiT is run on NCIT-DOID only; it does not terminate at SNOMED scale, so the SNOMED pairs carry ELK lower bounds only.

caveats.missing_cells: AML and LogMapLt on SNOMED-FMA (null): ELK exhausted a 384 GB heap (heap full for more than 10 minutes; watchdog kill record). The value is unknown, not infinite. The standard (unrepaired) SNOMED-FMA reference fails the same way, as do five participant SNOMED-FMA alignments; the cause is not established.
caveats.excluded_systems: Lexical-Baseline has coherence results for all three pairs but is omitted here to keep this table row-matched to the global P/R/F1 table above, from which it was deliberately dropped.
